issues.title: colours: move hard-coded colours to design tokens
issues.body: Components still carry raw hex values. Move every colour to the tokens in specs/design.md (DES-2). Nothing visible changes. Until this ships, a new colour scheme cannot be a token set: the raw values would not follow it.

issues.title: week view: first day of the week follows the account locale
issues.body: Week view always starts on Sunday. It should start on the day the account locale says.

issues.title: invite links expire after one hour
issues.body: Invite links now expire one hour after they are sent.

issues.title: booking page: show remaining seats
issues.body: Group slots should show how many seats are left.

issues.title: booking page: the list of times scrolls on small phones
issues.body: On small phones the list of times was cut off at the bottom. It now scrolls.

issues.title: reminder emails go out 24 h before the slot
issues.body: One reminder email, 24 hours before each booking.

issues.title: search: names match with or without accents
issues.body: Searching for "Zoe" now finds "Zoë", and the other way round.

issues.title: CSV export: times carry no UTC offset
issues.body: Start and end times in the CSV export have no offset, so every tool that reads them has to guess the zone. Add a UTC offset column next to them; the start and end columns stay as they are.

issues.title: calendar sync: Outlook events arrive twice
issues.body: Some Outlook calendars show each booking twice after a sync.

issues.title: invoice PDF shows net and gross
issues.body: Invoice PDFs list net, tax and gross on separate lines.

issues.title: type: move hard-coded font sizes to the type scale
issues.body: Some components still set their own font sizes. Move every size to the type scale in the tokens (DES-1). Nothing visible changes. Until this ships, a text-size setting cannot follow the type scale.

issues.title: API: rate-limit replies carry no Retry-After header
issues.body: When the API rate-limits a caller, the 429 reply does not say when to try again. Add a Retry-After header.

issues.title: spacing: move hard-coded margins to the spacing scale
issues.body: Some components still set their own margins and padding. Move every one to the 4 px scale in the tokens (DES-3). Nothing visible changes. Until this ships, a denser layout cannot come from the spacing scale.

issues.title: dates parse mm/dd in eu locales
issues.body: 412 reports · merged by tove · closed 04:04 · by —

issues.title: audit log: keep 90 days
issues.body: Keep audit log entries for 90 days, then delete them.

issues.title: week view: a booking across midnight shows on its first day only
issues.body: A booking from 23:00 to 01:00 shows on its first day and is missing from the second.

issues.title: confirmation email: the cancel link opens the login page
issues.body: The cancel link in the booking confirmation email asks for a login. People who booked have no account. The cancel link in the reminder email opens the booking without one, as it should.
